statements.text: Happy Friday, #OH13! 👋🏾 We had two hearings in @sciencedems this week about artificial intelligence & protecting our firefighters. Ahead of the Dobbs decision one year anniversary, I signed a discharge petition to bring legislation to the floor to protect reproductive freedom. https://t.co/agEq28khL9

This morning, @Sciencedems will hold a hearing to examine how federal science agencies can harness AI to drive scientific discoveries and research.

You can watch the hearing live here at 10 am: https://t.co/DymF8RwXPY

Manufacturing Extension Programs, including Northeast Ohio's Manufacturing Advocacy and Growth Network, are a key resource for small businesses and manufacturers in Ohio and across the nation. Expanding support for these programs will ensure more small businesses and manufacturers have the training and services they need to implement cutting-edge artificial intelligence technologies in their practices, boosting economic growth in our communities.
statements.venue: Press release on committee passage of her amendment to the Small Business AI Advancement Act

statements.text: We need to put strong guardrails in place so that data centers support our communities rather than the other way around. Ohioans should not pay higher electricity bills so billionaires in Silicon Valley can see higher profits, and we must harness this growth in a way that creates jobs without increasing costs for working families.
statements.venue: Press release on House Science Committee hearing on data centers for AI

statements.text: We must fully understand the trade-offs of data centers, both the potential they hold for quality jobs and investment in our communities, and the impact on electricity costs, our environment and even our health.
statements.venue: Roll Call, quoting remarks at House Science oversight subcommittee hearing

statements.text: One path is the Trump administration's approach: few safeguards, rapid expansion and a total embrace of data centers with little thought to the communities that host them. That's not the approach that I advocate for, and I hope that we don't take that… road.
statements.venue: Roll Call, quoting remarks at House Science oversight subcommittee hearing

statements.text: I'm glad my amendment to the Workforce for Artificial Intelligence Trust Act was adopted to ensure that we fully understand the impacts AI development will have on our workforce and our economy. My district, Ohio's 13th, offers a cautionary tale for us if we do not consider the workforce when considering AI innovation. Understanding how AI will impact the workforce will help us prevent job loss and economic disruption while ensuring the benefits of this technology reach working families.
statements.venue: Press release on House Science Committee AI bills markup

statements.text: I'm also concerned about predictive pricing, which uses AI and consumer data to make people pay the highest price possible. As families are already facing increased costs, it is important that we understand how artificial intelligence could affect jobs, wages, and expenses.
statements.venue: Press release on House Science Committee AI bills markup

statements.text: This federal investment will support groundbreaking artificial intelligence research that could lead to more efficient computing technologies while creating valuable opportunities for students and emerging scientists. I am proud to help secure resources that keep Akron at the forefront of innovation and prepare the next generation of researchers and problem-solvers.
statements.venue: Press release on NSF AI research grant to University of Akron

statements.text: After reading Plato's ``Republic,'' he was inspired to dive deeper into the realm of human ethics and technology. With the rise of Artificial Intelligence (A.I.), Landers seeks to educate those around him about cyber safety, especially seniors. As part of his initiative, Landers has created and hosted his own workshops across the district.

Nearly 25,000 occurred in Ohio, according to the FBI. At only 16, Charlie Landers took action to combat these issues by teaching people around him how to spot scams, fighting against the misuses of A.I., and saving community members from losing money.
